name: dotnet-pilot
description: .NET development plugin for Claude Code — Roslyn semantic analysis, DI/architecture/EF Core guards, convention-aware scaffolding, TDD agents, security and performance review, and project lifecycle commands.

build_status.title: Build failure toasts
build_status.description: Show a toast after 3 and 5 consecutive dotnet build/test failures (requires a Claude Code build with mods).

routing.title: Routing roster in system prompt
routing.description: Add the dotnet-pilot routing guidance to the system prompt once per session in .NET projects (requires a Claude Code build with mods).

pressure.title: Pressure meter
pressure.description: Score repeated red dotnet runs, re-edits and corrections 0–100 in the status line, warn on test edits that loosen a test after a red run, and add a short system-prompt section while the score is high (requires a Claude Code build with mods).

pressure_test_guard_block.title: Block loosening test edits under high pressure
pressure_test_guard_block.description: Deny an Edit that skips, removes or comments out a test assertion while the pressure score is 60 or higher. Off by default; the warning toast shows regardless.

pixel_city.title: Pixel city band
pixel_city.description: Draw an animated pixel-art band above the prompt in the terminal: a city, beach, running dinosaur or time-lapse sunset under a day/night sky that reacts to tool activity, with a storm on a failed dotnet build/test and a rainbow when it goes green. /city controls it (requires a Claude Code build with mods).

pixel_city_scene.title: Pixel band scene
pixel_city_scene.description: The scene the pixel band starts with: city, beach, dino (a running T-rex that jumps the cacti; meteors instead of rain in a storm) or sunset (a time-lapse sunrise-to-sunset over mountains and a lake). /city <scene> switches it for the session.
